dedupe_keys.name: a cyclist centric 360 panoramic dataset for safety critical object detection in real world cycling scenarios

description: A cyclist-centric 360° panoramic dataset for safety-critical object detection in real-world cycling scenarios is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Han Li et al. Cycling safety is becoming an increasingly significant challenge for urban transportation, and vision-based object detection technology for cycling scenes has been widely studied. Datasets are an essential component of studying object detection in cycling scenes. However, existing datasets often have limitations, including limited scene diversity and incomplete coverage of safety-critical objects. Coverage: global; published in 2026. Formats: JSON, TXT, XML, Image. The data are held in Zenodo and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
